decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall include the following soft landscaping areas as shown on and in accordance with the submitted plan received 05 November 2008: abutting the existing building shall be plants housed in a raised bed or equivalent; and between the car and pedestrian access path to the building shall be a line of brick pavers or equivalent interspersed with plants housed in plant boxes or equivalent extending from the edge of the public footpath to the existing building. The planted areas shall be constructed before the vehicle access is first brought into use and shall be permanently retained thereafter. The raised planters or beds shall not exceed 0.6 metres in height.
description: Creation of a vehicular access to front of site.
